description_en: Creates a data service API and submits it
description_zh: 创建新的数据服务API并提交
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public create-data-service-api --op-tenant-id 30001011 --create-command '{"ApiGroupName":"默认API分组","Description":"test","UpdateRate":1,"ApiName":"API_01","Timeout":30,"ReturnSqlSwitch":true,"Mode":0,"ApiGroupId":101,"CacheTimeout":600,"ProjectId":123,"CallMode":1,"CustomUpdateRate":"每天8点","RowPermissionIds":[12345],"Version":"V1","ExecutionTimeout":30,"DmlConfig":{},"ApiType":3,"ScriptDetails":{},"BizProtocol":[0],"RequestType":1}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataServiceApi

fields.help_en: The group ID of the API
fields.help_zh: Api的分组ID
fields.name: api_group_id

fields.help_en: The group name of the API
fields.help_zh: Api的分组名称
fields.name: api_group_name

fields.help_en: The name of the API
fields.help_zh: Api的名称
fields.name: api_name

fields.help_en:
The type of the API. Valid values:

3: datasource SQL mode
fields.help_zh:
Api的类型：

3：数据源SQL模式
fields.name: api_type

fields.help_en:
The protocol. Different gateway types support different protocols. For more information, see the documentation. Valid values:
0: HTTP 
1: HTTPS
fields.help_zh:
协议，不同的网关类型可支持的协议不同，请查看帮助文档，枚举值：
0：HTTP 
1：HTTPS
fields.name: biz_protocol

fields.help_en: The cache timeout period, in seconds
fields.help_zh: 缓存超时时间，单位为秒
fields.name: cache_timeout

fields.help_en:
The call mode of the API. Default value: 1. Valid values:

1: synchronous call
2: asynchronous call
fields.help_zh:
API的调用模式（默认值为1）：

1：同步调用
2：异步调用
fields.name: call_mode

fields.help_en: The custom update frequency. This parameter is required when the update frequency is set to custom
fields.help_zh: 自定义更新频率，当更新频率为自定义时为必填
fields.name: custom_update_rate

fields.help_en: The description of the API
fields.help_zh: Api的描述信息
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The data volume per batch. Valid values:
When the data volume type is single record, this parameter cannot be set.
When the data volume type is batch:
If the transaction processing mode is 1, this parameter cannot be set.
If the transaction processing mode is 2, the value ranges from 1 to 1000000
fields.help_zh:
单批处理数据量：
单条数据量时，单批处理数据量不允许设置
批量数据量时：
事务处理模式为1时，单批处理数据量不允许设置
事务处理模式为2时，单批处理数据量为1~1000000
fields.name: batch_input_data_size

fields.help_en:
The data volume type. Valid values:
1: single record
2: batch
fields.help_zh:
数据量：
1: 单条
2: 批量
fields.name: data_volume_type

fields.help_en:
The error handling method. Valid values:
1: partial success allowed
2: all must succeed

Parameter rules:
When the data volume type is single record, this parameter cannot be set.
When the data volume type is batch, the value is 1 or 2
fields.help_zh:
错误处理方式：
1: 允许部分成功
2: 全部成功才可成功

传参规则：
单条数据量时，错误处理方式不允许设置
批量数据量时，错误处理方式为1或2
fields.name: error_handling_type

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of input records. Valid values:
When the data volume type is single record, this parameter cannot be set.
When the data volume type is batch, the value ranges from 1 to 1000000
fields.help_zh:
最大输入条数：
单条数据量时，最大输入条数不允许设置
批量数据量时，最大输入条数为1~1000000
fields.name: max_input_data_size

fields.help_en:
The degree of parallelism. Valid values:
When the data volume type is single record, this parameter cannot be set.
When the data volume type is batch:
If the transaction processing mode is 1, this parameter cannot be set.
If the transaction processing mode is 2, the value ranges from 1 to 5
fields.help_zh:
并行度：
单条数据量时，并行度不允许设置
批量数据量时：
事务处理模式为1时，并行度不允许设置
事务处理模式为2时，并行度支持设置1~5
fields.name: parallel_num

fields.help_en:
The transaction processing mode. Valid values:
0: no transaction
1: no batching
2: batch processing

Parameter rules:
When the data volume type is single record, the transaction processing mode is 0.
When the data volume type is batch:
If the error handling method is 1, the transaction processing mode is 1 or 2.
If the error handling method is 2, the transaction processing mode can only be 1
fields.help_zh:
事务处理模式：
0: 无事务
1: 不分批
2: 分批处理

传参规则：
单条数据量时，事务处理模式为0
批量数据量时：
错误处理方式为1时，事务处理模式为1或2
错误处理方式为2时，事务处理模式只能为1
fields.name: transaction_type

fields.help_en: The configuration of the operation-type API. This parameter is not required when creating a query-type API
fields.help_zh: 操作类API配置信息，新建查询类API时无需配置
fields.name: dml_config

fields.help_en: The execution timeout period for asynchronous API calls. This parameter takes effect only for asynchronous API calls and is required when the call mode is asynchronous
fields.help_zh: 异步调用API执行超时时间，仅对异步调用API生效，异步调用时必填
fields.name: execution_timeout

fields.help_en:
The development mode of the API. Valid values:

0: Basic mode 
1: Dev-Prod mode
fields.help_zh:
Api的开发模式：

0：Basic模式 
1：Dev-Prod模式
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The ID of the data service project
fields.help_zh: 数据服务项目ID
fields.name: project_id

fields.help_en:
The request method of the API. Valid values:

0 (GET): Returns a single record. The query result is unique. 
1 (LIST): Returns multiple records.
2 (CREATE): Creates objects. Supports single or batch creation.
3 (UPDATE): Updates objects. Supports single or batch updates.
4 (DELETE): Deletes objects. Supports single or batch deletions
fields.help_zh:
Api的请求方式：

0（GET）：仅返回单条，查询结果唯一 
1（LIST）：返回多条
2（CREATE）：创建对象，可支持单条或批量创建
3（UPDATE）：更新对象，可支持单条或批量更新
4（DELETE）：删除对象，可支持单条或批量删除
fields.name: request_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to return the SQL in the result
fields.help_zh: 结果是否返回SQL
fields.name: return_sql_switch

fields.help_en: The list of row-level permission IDs
fields.help_zh: 行级权限ID列表
fields.name: row_permission_ids

fields.help_en: The ID of the datasource. This parameter is required when the API mode is direct datasource connection
fields.help_zh: 数据源的ID，API模式为直连数据源时必填
fields.name: datasource_id

fields.help_en:
The data type on which the API is based. Valid values:
1: datasource
fields.help_zh:
API基于的数据类型  ：
1：数据源
fields.name: datasource_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to paginate the results. This parameter is required only when RequestType is set to List. Default value: false. Pagination is not supported in asynchronous call mode
fields.help_zh: 结果是否分页，仅当RequestType模式为List时才需要（默认为false），且异步调用模式不支持
fields.name: is_paginated

fields.example: select a,b,c from table1 where d = ${d}
